native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the unlocked stone bearing the smallest owed letter (select the minimum-labelled unsettled node).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by its thief's toll, one direction at a time (directed, per-edge non-negative weights relaxed outward from the current node).
A locked garden letter is never rebuilt again, and threads reaching nowhere are dropped and thrown away (settled labels are final; failed relaxations/unreachable nodes are discarded at infinity).
core_technique: Standard non-negative single-source Dijkstra over a CSR adjacency, with a two-regime priority queue: SIMD (AVX2) linear argmin scan over a compact frontier array while the frontier is small (<=2048), then a one-time switch to a 3-ary indexed min-heap with true decrease-key, plus software prefetching of relaxation targets.
